sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
### Exercise 1: Parallel Downloader

Create a URL downloader:

1. Accept list of URLs
2. Download in parallel
3. Show progress
4. Handle failures

### Exercise 2: Parallel Search

Search files for a pattern:

1. List all files in directory
2. Search each file in parallel
3. Return matching lines
4. Use ThreadPoolExecutor

### Exercise 3: Image Processor

Process images in parallel:

1. Accept folder of images
2. Apply transformation
3. Use ProcessPoolExecutor
4. Save results

### Exercise 4: Rate-Limited Executor

Create rate-limited executor:

1. Max N requests per second
2. Queue excess requests
3. Return futures

### Exercise 5: Retry Wrapper

Create retry wrapper:

1. Retry failed tasks
2. Exponential backoff
3. Max retries limit

### Exercise 6: Progress Tracker

Create progress tracker:

1. Track submitted tasks
2. Track completed tasks
3. Show progress bar
4. ETA calculation

### Exercise 7: Priority Executor

Create priority task queue:

1. High/medium/low priority
2. Process high first
3. Fair scheduling

### Exercise 8: Batch Executor

Create batch processor:

1. Collect tasks
2. Execute in batches
3. Wait for batch
4. Return all results

### Exercise 9: Hybrid Executor

Create hybrid executor:

1. ThreadPool for I/O
2. ProcessPool for CPU
3. Auto-select based on task

### Exercise 10: Timeout Executor

Create timeout executor:

1. Cancel slow tasks
2. Return partial results
3. Report timed-out tasks
